title: Magnitude 5.1 earthquake jolts Valderrama town in Antique
summary: MANILA, Philippines — A magnitude 5.1 earthquake jolted the town of Valderrama in Antique on Wednesday morning, Nov. 25, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A magnitude 5.1 earthquake jolted the town of Valderrama in Antique on Wednesday morning, Nov. 25, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs). In an advisory, Phivolcs said the tectonic earthquake occurred at 7:29 a.m., approximately 14 kilometers (km) southeast of Valderrama, Antique, at a depth of 10 km.
